title: On the Challenges of Building Datasets for Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing how the socio-demographic backgrounds (e.g., race, gender, political leaning) and lived experiences of annotators introduce subjectivity into ground-truth labels, and proposing a 7-step data-centric framework to systematically mitigate and document this bias during dataset creation.

Utilized as a continuous running case study (Task T) to demonstrate the application of the proposed framework, illustrating how to define hate, select data sources, and design annotation schemas specifically for hate speech against sexual minorities.
